description: Test fixture manifest documenting expected properties for each PDF file. Used by unit and property-based tests to verify correct behavior. Every entry describes what the current binary returns; a deliberate behaviour change shows up as a diff of this file.

conventions.decodedStreamLength: byte length of getImageStreamData(); null means the call fails (qpdf cannot decode the filter chain) and never returns undecoded bytes
conventions.rawStreamLength: byte length of getRawImageStreamData(); null when it depends on the zlib implementation (Flate-encoded payloads)

simple-one-image.pdf.description: Single uncompressed 2x2 RGB image on one page

multi-image.pdf.description: 3 images across 2 pages. Page 1: 4x4 RGB + 2x2 Gray. Page 2: 3x3 RGB.

no-images.pdf.description: Valid PDF with text content only, no image XObjects

jpeg-compressed.pdf.description: Single 2x2 grayscale image with DCTDecode (JPEG) compression
jpeg-compressed.pdf.notes: rawStreamLength is the byte length of the embedded JPEG data (variable depending on JPEG encoding). decodedStreamLength is 2*2*1 = 4 bytes of uncompressed grayscale pixels.

nested-forms.pdf.description: One image directly on the page (2x2 RGB), one image inside a Form XObject (3x3 RGB). Tests recursive enumeration.

smask-pair.pdf.description: 2x2 RGB picture (obj 5) whose /SMask points at a 2x2 gray image (obj 6); both are page resources.

stencil-mask-pair.pdf.description: 2x2 RGB picture (obj 5) with a stencil /Mask stream (obj 6, /ImageMask true); both are page resources. The stencil mask is not listed by the current binary (qpdf's forEachImage excludes /ImageMask streams).

colorkey-mask.pdf.description: 2x2 RGB picture with a colour-key /Mask array.

imagemask-decode.pdf.description: A single 8x2 stencil mask (/ImageMask true, 1 bpc, /Decode [1 0]). Not listed by the current binary (qpdf's forEachImage excludes /ImageMask streams).

iccbased-n3-n1.pdf.description: Im1: /ColorSpace is an indirect reference to [ /ICCBased 8 0 R ] with /N 3. Im2: direct array [ /ICCBased 9 0 R ] with /N 1.

indexed-rgb.pdf.description: Im1: Indexed over DeviceRGB, 8 bpc, hival 3, lookup as hex string. Im2: Indexed over DeviceRGB, 4 bpc, hival 1, lookup as Flate stream (obj 7).

separation-devicen.pdf.description: Im1: Separation /Spot over DeviceCMYK with a type 2 tint transform. Im2: DeviceN [ /Cyan /Magenta ] over DeviceCMYK with a type 4 tint transform.

dct-indirect-colorspace.pdf.description: 2x2 gray JPEG whose /ColorSpace is an indirect reference (obj 6) to [ /ICCBased 7 0 R ], /N 1: the "940 0 R" case from the handoff.

flate-dct-chain.pdf.description: 2x2 gray JPEG wrapped in Flate: /Filter [ /FlateDecode /DCTDecode ]. qpdf decodes the whole chain (libjpeg) to 4 samples.

jpx-flate-chain.pdf.description: JPX payload wrapped in Flate, /SMaskInData 1, no /ColorSpace and no /BitsPerComponent (allowed for JPX). qpdf cannot decode JPX, so getImageStreamData fails for the whole chain; the payload bytes are opaque placeholders.

ccitt-1bit.pdf.description: 8x2 1-bpc gray image, /Filter /CCITTFaxDecode with /DecodeParms << /K -1 /Columns 8 /BlackIs1 true >>. Opaque placeholder payload; qpdf cannot decode CCITT.

jbig2-globals.pdf.description: 8x2 1-bpc gray image, /Filter /JBIG2Decode with /DecodeParms << /JBIG2Globals 6 0 R >>. Opaque placeholder payloads; qpdf cannot decode JBIG2.

codec-not-last.pdf.description: Invalid chain /Filter [ /DCTDecode /FlateDecode ] (codec before container filter). qpdf fails decoding (libjpeg sees zlib bytes).

shared-image-3-pages.pdf.description: One 2x2 RGB image XObject (obj 7) referenced from the resources of all three pages; the content stream is shared as well.

rotated-page.pdf.description: Page 0: explicit /MediaBox [0 0 400 300] and /Rotate 90. Page 1: inherits both from the page tree root. Page 2: invalid /Rotate 45. No images, no /Resources (qpdf warns and repairs).

no-mediabox.pdf.description: One page without any /MediaBox (own or inherited). qpdf repairs the missing box to Letter during page tree traversal and warns.
facts: getPageInfo mediaBox when the PDF has none

filter-abbreviations.pdf.description: 2x2 RGB image compressed with Flate, written with the inline-image abbreviation /Fl. qpdf accepts the abbreviation; the filter string is reported as written.
